s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Combination Light Body Packing LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear combination light body packing LH.

item.ptxt: If it is stuck to the body, be sure to peel it all off.
Once removed, be sure to replace it with a service rear combination light body packing LH, as it may cause water leakage.

s2.ptxt: Turn in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and separate the back-up light bulb together with the rear combination light socket & wire sub-assembly LH.
Remove the back-up light bulb from the rear combination light socket & wire sub-assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Turn Signal Light Bulb

s2.ptxt: Turn in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and separate the rear turn signal light bulb together with the rear combination light socket & wire sub-assembly LH.
Remove the rear turn signal light bulb from the rear combination light socket & wire sub-assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Combination Light Socket & Wire Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the claw and clamp, and remove the rear combination light socket & wire sub-assembly LH.
